svg.title: 3. Uploads and weekly digest
svg.text: A. Recipe photo upload (Lambda never touches the bytes)
B. Weekly digest: 50,000 emails without a traffic spike of its own
Keep slow work off the request path: photo uploads and the weekly email digest
form POST straight to S3, 5 minutes to use it
writes thumbs/ (outside the trigger prefix, so no loop)
key fixed to the caller's prefix
Max concurrency 5 keeps the send rate inside the SES quota. A failed batch retries,
then lands in the DLQ instead of looping. Lambda and SQS cost cents; SES is about $8 per 50,000 emails.
